review_note: Reviewed all 124 chronological originals and enlarged grips, recoil and recovery. Excluded originals 12-17 containing an unwanted flash and trimmed long stationary holds. The brief 11-to-18 impact transition leads into retained backward torso/arm recoil, bent supporting knee and full recovery to ready. Sixteen original poses over 560 ms; no flash in selected footage, reversed frames, duplicate padding or painted reconstruction.
